fixture_correction_reason: The original four-row DC spike did not guarantee a width3 winner: a drifting width1 path could hit the DC spike in three later rows and achieve a larger score. The original fixture assertion was invalid; no numerical test was executed before this correction.
corrected_fixture_static_proof: The reference channel is1040 and dt0=0. The only nonzero cell is in source row0 at DC1039 or1041. Only window0 includes that source row.
Every width1 hypothesis has center1040 in its first chosen row and therefore misses the adjacent row0 spike. All other source rows are zero, so all width1 scores are zero.

Every supported width3 hypothesis in window0 includes the adjacent DC at the inclusive first-row boundary. Its positive raw score exceeds every width1 score, so the first raw maximum is window0/width3/ascending drift index0.

All width3 hypotheses contact DC at their first chosen row and are inadmissible for clean maximization. The first width1 drift index0 moves away from either adjacent center in later rows, remains supported and yields a clean zero-score alternative. Strict first ties select window0/width1/index0.
The fixture therefore exercises inclusive boundaries and recovery of a clean alternative without relying on an outcome-sensitive inequality.
